snippet.title: poncle presents | Kill the Brickman - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Say goodbye to your productivity and get bricked up with us in Kill the Brickman, out now on Steam and Xbox 💥

Build your own bullet-blasting loadouts by combining relics, clip layouts, and bizarre bullets that explode, corrode and multiply!

Every run is a new experiment. Every build is a puzzle. Every bullet is a brick-busting tool to bring home the bank 🤑 

🔗 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3123120/Kill_the_Brickman
🔗 Steam News: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3123120/view/502834059926306951
🔗 FAQ: https://poncle.games/kill-the-brickman-faq.html
🔗 Doonutsaur Twitter: https://x.com/doonutsaur
